keyPoints.en: Tropical rainforest: lowland dipterocarp (<300 m), hill and upper dipterocarp, montane (>1,200 m). Layers: emergent, canopy, understorey, shrub, floor.
keyPoints.bm: Hutan hujan tropika: dipterokarpa tanah pamah (<300 m), dipterokarpa bukit dan atas, pergunungan (>1,200 m). Lapisan: teratas, silara, bawah silara, renek, lantai.

keyPoints.en: Mangrove (muddy coasts, e.g. Matang), freshwater and peat swamp (waterlogged land), beach forest (rhu, ketapang).
keyPoints.bm: Paya bakau (pantai berlumpur, cth. Matang), paya air tawar dan gambut (tanah bertakung), hutan pantai (rhu, ketapang).

keyPoints.en: Climate (hot, wet), altitude (cooler higher up), soil and drainage decide which forest type grows where.
keyPoints.bm: Iklim (panas, lembap), altitud (lebih sejuk di tempat tinggi), tanih dan saliran menentukan jenis hutan di sesuatu tempat.

keyPoints.en: Oxygen and carbon storage, wildlife habitat, water catchment, prevents erosion, timber and medicine, tourism and research; mangroves protect coasts.
keyPoints.bm: Oksigen dan simpanan karbon, habitat hidupan liar, kawasan tadahan air, mencegah hakisan, kayu balak dan ubat, pelancongan dan penyelidikan; bakau melindungi pantai.

keyPoints.en: Logging, agriculture, housing and mining cause erosion, landslides, floods, sedimentation, loss of habitat and haze from peat fires.
keyPoints.bm: Pembalakan, pertanian, perumahan dan perlombongan menyebabkan hakisan, tanah runtuh, banjir, pemendapan, kehilangan habitat dan jerebu daripada kebakaran gambut.

tip.en: Always link a human activity to its effect.
tip.bm: Sentiasa kaitkan kegiatan manusia dengan kesannya.
